description: Read the latest actual received event in the selected workspace, across all subscribers. Requires subscribers:read. Returns sample: null when none exists. Copy sample.properties into start_sequence_test_run customVariables, editing as needed. This read does not fire an event or change the selected test recipient. Unlike get_event_schema, this is recorded account data, with no age cutoff.

companyId.description: Company ID; defaults to the selected company.

eventName.description: Exact recorded event name after trimming surrounding whitespace, including custom events.

name: get_event_sample

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_event_sample` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sample.description: Latest received event across workspace subscribers, or null. Contains eventTime (UTC), subscriberId and properties (JSON object). No age cutoff. Copy properties to test customVariables.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
